status: Render and sewing pattern; keyboard inputs as listed, encoder knob height assumed

notes.keyboard: Same keyboard inputs as the Corne dock: the 8.2 mm case/plate profile is from Keebart's product image; the 16 mm keycap height and 2 mm feet are earlier rocklabs assumptions. The half outline is the upstream foostan Corne v4 3x6 case, not a Keebart drawing.
notes.encoder: Knob size and height are not known. 5 mm above the keycaps is an assumption; measure yours and rebuild if it sits higher.
notes.sleeve: One rectangle per half, folded at the far end and sewn up both sides. Girth allowance covers the 3 mm fabric wrapping round the half, so the sleeve is snug. The mouth needs no hem because neoprene does not fray.
notes.hinge: The two sleeves are sewn together along their folded ends on the keycap side, so the case opens flat and folds shut like a book with the halves face to face.
notes.elastic: The strap is one closed loop of 30 mm elastic, cut at 85 % of the closed book's girth plus a 20 mm overlap for sewing it shut.
